A_text: The system should support a ticketing data model which allows a guest to purchase and manage multiple tickets (portfolio of tickets) under their account.
B_text: Support purchase, ownership, management, and consumption of multiple tickets, passes, memberships, and entitlements under a single portfolio.

A_text: The system should allow multiple portfolios to be linked only to one account.
B_text: Support multiple portfolios linked to a single account representing individuals, dependents, employees, students, or group participants.

A_text: The system should provide the ability to move stored credit between portfolios linked to different accounts. For Example: each family member have their own portfolio with the possibility to transfer part of the stored credit between the portfolios enabled in the system. At the end, each expenditure should be tracked independently by portfolio (family member).
B_text: Allow configurable transfer of stored value, wallet balances, promotional credits, and vouchers between linked portfolios with full audit tracking.

A_text: The system should be able to print media which are linked to guest's portfolios, this way multiple media can be availed/printed to the same guest portfolio. (examples: lost/soiled ticket reprints, website order's printing  QR code prints)
B_text: Support issuance and management of QR codes, RFID wristbands, RFID cards, NFC passes, digital tickets, and printed tickets linked to portfolios.

A_text: Multiple Queue Types: First-come-first-serve, priority/VIP, group queues.
B_text: Support First-Come-First-Served, Virtual Queue, Fast Pass, VIP Queue, Express Queue, Group Queue, Membership Queue, Accessibility Queue, and Staff Queue.

A_text: Real-time Queue Dashboard: Staff view of queue lengths, wait times, and customer flow.
B_text: Allow administrators to create and configure unlimited virtual queues with capacities, operating hours, eligibility rules, and queue logic.

A_text: Manual Overrides: Staff can move guests up/down or reassign them.
B_text: Display queue lengths, wait times, throughput, capacity utilization, occupancy, and customer flow metrics.

A_text: VIP / Priority Handling: Separate or fast-track queues for premium guests.
B_text: Automatically assign guests to queues based on ticket type, attraction, capacity availability, reservation rules, guest profile, or business policies.

A_text: Load Balancing: Redirect customers to less busy queues/rides/entry points.
B_text: Configure queue capacities by hour, day, attraction, session, ticket type, membership level, or sales channel.

A_text: SMS, email, or whats app , app push notifications when it’s nearly their turn.
B_text: Allow authorized users to add, remove, move, prioritize, or reassign guests within queues.

A_text: Real-time updates on remaining wait time.
B_text: Support priority queueing for VIP guests, annual pass holders, premium packages, loyalty tiers, and accessibility requirements.

A_text: Accessibility Features: Special accommodations for disabled or elderly guests based on the profile of the customer
B_text: Automatically recommend or redirect guests to alternative attractions or queues.
